name: personal-brand-strategy
description:
Defines professional positioning including unique value proposition, target audience,
platform selection, content themes, and a 90-day visibility plan. Produces a complete
brand strategy document.
Use when the user wants to build a personal brand, establish thought leadership,
increase professional visibility, or create a content strategy for career growth.
Do NOT use for LinkedIn profile writing (use linkedin-summary-writer), resume writing
(use resume-bullet-writer), or social media marketing for a business (use content-marketing skills).
